pages.title: Enemy Ootachi
pages.text: Ootachi-type monsters. Ootachi-type monsters have extremely slow attack and movement speed, use splash area-of-effect damage, and have average spawn frequency.

pages.name: Enemy Ootachi
pages.text: The basic ootachi unit of the Retrograde Army. Large in size, with extremely slow attack speed.

pages.name: Enemy Specialized Ootachi
pages.text: A specialized enemy ootachi with slightly increased attack power, posing a greater threat.

pages.name: Enemy Kiwame Ootachi
pages.text: The Kiwame form of enemy ootachi, possessing higher splash area-of-effect damage. A relatively high threat.
